outputContract.format: Return exactly one valid JSON object. Do not include markdown or explanation.
important: Do not use a metadata object as the only place for title, attackType, language, framework, difficulty, theme, or description.
All required fields must exist at the top level.
vulnerableFiles must be a non-empty array of objects with path and content.
solutionFiles must be a non-empty array of objects with path and content.
Do not use vulnerableFiles as an object map.
Do not use solutionFiles as an object map.
expectedBehavior must be an object with vulnerable and fixed fields.

nodeExpressStaticValidatorRules: Both vulnerableFiles and solutionFiles must include package.json and app.js.
Each file object must use path and content fields.
app.js must import Express using require("express").
app.js must create the app using exactly: const app = express();
app.js must define the port using exactly: const port = process.env.PORT || 3000;
app.js must define at least one direct route using app.get(...).
app.js must be readable multi-line JavaScript with at least 8 non-empty lines.
xssRules: The vulnerable app must reflect user input into HTML without escaping.
The vulnerable app must not define or call escapeHtml.
The solution app must define an escapeHtml function.
The solution app must call escapeHtml on user-controlled input before rendering.
Do not use encodeURIComponent as the XSS fix.
The security payload must include an obvious XSS payload such as <script>alert(1)</script>.
expectedVulnerableResult must contain the raw script payload.
